messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] A spatio-temporal model for 3K+ observations crashes during a build
parts:
do you have access to a larger computer with more memory?


On Mon, 2019-12-23 at 23:04 -0800, Insang Song wrote:
> I am currently fitting a spatio-temporal model with two random
> slopes and a spatial and a temporal random effect.
> Even though the dataset is not too large (3,108*14=43234 rows * 10
> columns), the model crashes during its build process.
> The other model for spatial subset (400*14=5,600 rows * 10 columns)
> is run smoothly.
> For your reference, the spatial contiguity matrix is of lag 2.
>
> The example code is:
>
> form.bp <- Mortrate ~
> 0 +
> f(GEOID1, model = "bym", graph = graph, group = year, constr =
> TRUE, scale.model = TRUE) +
> f(year3, model = 'ar1', group = GEOID4, constr = TRUE) +
> f(GEOID2, UELAG1, model = "bym", graph = graph, group = year1,
> control.group = list(model = "ar", order = 1),
> constr = TRUE, scale.model = TRUE) +
> f(GEOID3, UELAG2, model = "bym", graph = graph, group = year2,
> control.group = list(model = "ar", order = 1),
> constr = TRUE, scale.model = TRUE) +
> PELDER + PNONWHITE + I(MEDINCOME/1000) + PUNIVABOVE + PPOVTBELOW
> + PRURAL + PRENTER + PHSINGLE
>
>
> finla <- inla(formula = form.bp, data = data.pu,
> control.compute = list(waic = TRUE, dic = TRUE, cpo
> = TRUE),
> verbose = TRUE,
> num.threads = 10,
> control.inla = control.inla(strategy =
> "simplified.laplace", int.strategy = "eb"), #diagonal = 1e4
> control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
> control.mode = list(theta = rep(0, 13), restart =
> TRUE))
>
